units.source_text: 夕雾在自己室中仔细打扮，到了夕暮过后才来到内大臣邸，大家等得心焦了。

en.t: Yugiri dressed himself with great care in his own rooms and did not arrive at the Inner Minister's residence until after dusk, leaving everyone waiting anxiously.

units.source_text: 做主人的诸公子，自柏木以下七八人，一齐出来迎接，陪同夕雾入内。

en.t: The young gentlemen of the household, seven or eight of them from Kashiwagi downward, all came out together to welcome him and escort Yugiri inside.

units.source_text: 座上诸人相貌都很俊美，但夕雾尤为出众，艳丽而清秀。

en.t: All those seated there were very handsome, but Yugiri stood out above the rest, radiant and refined.

units.source_text: 其气度之高雅，令人心生敬爱。

en.t: The elegance of his bearing inspired both affection and respect.

units.source_text: 内大臣吩咐侍者仔细安排客座，自己也整饰衣冠，准备出席。

en.t: The Inner Minister ordered the attendants to arrange the guest seats carefully, then adjusted his own court robes and prepared to appear.

units.source_text: 他对夫人身边的青年侍女们说道：“你们都来窥看！

en.t: He said to the young gentlewomen attending his wife, "Come and take a look, all of you!

units.source_text: 夕雾公子年龄渐长，相貌越发标致了。

en.t: Prince Yugiri has grown older, and his looks have become still more splendid.

units.source_text: 他的一举一动，都从容不迫，落落大方。

en.t: His every movement is calm, unhurried, and gracefully poised.

units.source_text: 其光明磊落、老成持重之相，竟胜过他的父亲呢！

en.t: His open, upright manner and mature steadiness surpass even his father!

units.source_text: 源氏大臣的相貌一味优雅温柔，教人看了自会面露笑容而忘却人世一切苦劳。

en.t: Lord Genji's features are wholly graceful and gentle; anyone who sees him naturally smiles and forgets all the hardships of this world.

units.source_text: 但在朝廷大会上，这相貌似乎缺乏严肃，而太偏于风流，这原是当然之理。

en.t: But at great court assemblies, those features seem to lack solemnity and to lean too much toward romantic elegance, which is only natural.

units.source_text: 这位夕雾公子则才学渊博，气度豪雄，世人都承认他是个毫无缺陷的完人呢。”

en.t: This Prince Yugiri, however, is deeply learned and grand in bearing, and everyone acknowledges him as a flawless, complete man."

units.source_text: 说过之后，整一整衣冠，便出去与夕雾会面。

en.t: After saying this, he straightened his robes once more and went out to meet Yugiri.

units.source_text: 略说了几句彬彬有礼的应酬之词以后，就移座赏花饮酒。

en.t: After exchanging a few courteous formalities, they moved seats to enjoy the flowers and drink wine.
